sourceCommitSemantics: Existing helper validates the fixed commit literal syntax only. It does not require checkout HEAD equality or independently establish installed App identity. Parent has separately verified installed18470; later diagnostic-only checkout changes do not invalidate this constant.

staticReview.role: Read-only verification of reused pinned helper, followed by authorship and byte/AST self-check of only three literal rebindings. This does not claim a separate non-author review of newly authored capture logic.
staticReview.writeScope: Original app metadata is byte-read through owned no-follow handles. SQLite is opened only on new private second-working-copy and consolidated backup paths under capture. Manifest/backup/receipt files are exclusive; helper never launches/quits/installs/restores.
staticReview.stability: Process absence is checked before capture, after complete manifest and at completion; raw metadata inventories and pinned source modules are rechecked. Absence does not prove normal quit or continuous absence between observations.
staticReview.freshCapture: Use inherited phase before exactly once to create a new post-UI snapshot and standalone metadata backup. The phase name before means before any further operation in this new capture directory; it is NOT the pre-UI baseline.
staticReview.comparison: This invocation does not compare with prior install/pre-UI evidence. Parent must separately compare complete manifests and the captured standalone DB against its sealed baseline; mutations must not be silently reclassified as retention success.
staticReview.failures: Preserve partial outputs and failure receipt; no automatic retry, restoration or deletion. Do not reuse an occupied capture destination.
